content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Higher stipend (a) for candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET, GATE or national level exams of DBT/DST; lower stipend (b) for others. HRA only if institutional accommodation is not availed/provided. The engagement will initially be for a period of One Year or until the project duration, whichever is earlier Total tenure shall not exceed six years including engagement in all CSIR labs

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Project Associate - II, 1 Project Associate - I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of submission of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: i.) 35,000 + HRA OR ii) 28,000 + HRA for Project Associate - II, i.) 31,000 + HRA OR ii) 25,000 + HRA for Project Associate - I.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry or Bachelor's degree in Engineering. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR-IIIM must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) before applying.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Forms submitted after 31 October 2026, 05:00 PM shall not be entertained and summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is to be done on the basis of Interview. Written examination may be conducted for screening if required. Online interview through MS Teams.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The engagement will initially be for a period of One Year or until the project duration, whichever is earlier. Total tenure shall not exceed six years including engagement in all CSIR labs.
